|lore=Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of Emperor. Encased in armor with cybernetic life support. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Was the best starpilot in the galaxy. Cunning warrior.
|versions={{Card versions/Darth Vader (Premiere)}}
|errata_history={{Card errata/Darth Vader}}
|strategy=By Michael Sharp, Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20021114054040/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/darthvader.html</ref>

What more can you say? This is [[Darth Vader]], perhaps one of the most used and most loved Star Wars CCG cards.

With power of 6 he is definately a character of choice in battles, and also has the nice touch of adding +1 to EACH battle destiny draw. So now you don't need to worry about drawing that location that you know is coming up. All this and he's immune to attrition &lt;5.

Combos:

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] - What an awesome combo! Power 10, a +1 to battle destiny draws, and the ability to cancel one of the Light Side's destiny draws!

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] + [[Vader's Cape]] (deployed on [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]]) - POWER COMBO! Power 10, a +1 +1 to battle destiny draws, the ability to cancel one of the Light Side's destiny draws, and both are immune to attrition &lt;5!

|notes=* Decipher published this errata as text only, in the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998). The main image is that Glossary entry. Printed face: [[Darth Vader]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].
* Decipher's [[Darth Vader (Reflections Foil)|Reflections foil]] (12 January 2000) prints a related text, not these exact words. Its first and last sentences match the errata ('adds 1 to each of your battle destiny draws', 'anything he pilots') but the Custom TIE clause is reworded: card 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (or 4 to power and 3 to maneuver if Vader's Custom TIE).'; Decipher errata 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Vader's Custom TIE adds 4 to power and 3 to maneuver.'
* No black-bordered card with Decipher's exact wording exists yet. The Players Committee's D-E1 card ([[Darth Vader (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]) is not word for word Decipher's: it prints "(or 4 to power and 3 to maneuver if Vader's Custom TIE)" where Decipher prints "When piloting Vader's Custom TIE adds 4 to power and 3 to maneuver".

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text only in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher never printed a card with this wording.
